svg.metadata: {"id": "s099", "name": "极地冰川", "cat": "自然与地理", "tags": ["科学", "地理", "气候变化", "动物"], "desc": "南极冰川的极昼黄昏：淡粉天际与绿色极光，层层冰山与冰崖，冷蓝海面漂着浮冰，近景冰原上站着一群企鹅。", "stand": {"ground_y": 930, "x": [480, 1440]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "stars", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.15, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "aurora", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.3, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "sun_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "bergs_far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sea", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.2, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}, {"name": "ice_cliff", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floes", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.55, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}, {"name": "ice_field", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "penguins", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sparkle", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#35507F", "sky2": "#7FA6D0", "sky3": "#F4D8E2", "aur": "#7FF0C8", "aur2": "#9AD7FF", "star": "#FFFFFF", "ice1": "#F2FBFF", "ice2": "#CDEBF6", "ice3": "#A3D3E8", "ice4": "#7FBAD6", "sea1": "#4F86B4", "sea2": "#7FB0D4", "sea3": "#BFDDEE", "peng": "#26303E", "peng2": "#FFFFFF", "beak": "#F2A33A", "snow": "#FFFFFF"}}
